label: MRtrix3 fixelconnectivity
description:
Generate a fixel-fixel connectivity matrix

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: threshold
parameters.description: a threshold to define the required fraction of shared connections to be included in the neighbourhood (default: 0.01)
parameters.usage: a threshold to define the required fraction of shared connections to be included in the neighbourhood (default: 0.01)  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: angle
parameters.description: the max angle threshold for assigning streamline tangents to fixels (Default: 45 degrees)
parameters.usage: the max angle threshold for assigning streamline tangents to fixels (Default: 45 degrees)  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: fixel_directory
input_slots.description: the directory containing the fixels between which connectivity will be quantified

input_slots.label: tracks
input_slots.description: the tracks used to determine fixel-fixel connectivity

input_slots.label: mask
input_slots.description: provide a fixel data file containing a mask of those fixels to be computed; fixels outside the mask will be empty in the output matrix

output_slots.label: matrix
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Generate a fixel-fixel connectivity matrix
